svg.title: A group audit with matched row counts
svg.desc: Both training sets have 240 rows from 80 groups; the identical 40 final-visit test rows represent 40 groups. The proper training set has no test-group overlap. The deliberately contaminated set replaces 40 proper training groups with the 40 test groups and uses only their other visits. Test row IDs remain disjoint in both cases.
